preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 200,000.
The number of rows in the grid is between 2 and 500,000.
The number of columns in the grid is between 2 and 500,000.
The grid contains only empty cells ('.') and walls ('#').

preconditions.expression: The sum of N * M over all test cases does not exceed 5 * 10^5
preconditions.description: The total number of cells in all grids does not exceed 500,000.

preconditions.expression: The starting cell (1, 1) is not blocked by a wall
preconditions.description: The top-left cell is always empty.

postconditions.description: The output is a non-negative integer representing the minimum number of airstrikes needed.

postconditions.expression: output == 0 implies all paths from (1, 1) to (N, M) are not blocked
postconditions.description: If no airstrikes are needed, then there exists at least one path from the start to the end without walls.

postconditions.expression: output == 1 implies there is a single row or column such that all walls are on that row or column
postconditions.description: If only one airstrike is needed, then all walls are on a single row or column.

postconditions.expression: output > 1 implies there are at least two rows or columns such that all walls are on those rows or columns
postconditions.description: If more than one airstrike is needed, then there are at least two rows or columns with walls.

invariants.expression: all(S_{i, j} in {'.', '#'} for i in range(N) for j in range(M))
invariants.description: The grid contains only empty cells ('.') and walls ('#').
The starting cell (1, 1) is always empty.
